title.zh: Google’s Genie 4 world model adds audio, more realistic worlds, and real-time steering
title.en: Google’s Genie 4 world model adds audio, more realistic worlds, and real-time steering

current_state.zh: Google DeepMind unveiled Genie 4, a world model that generates more realistic simulated environments with real-time audio and lets trusted testers steer simulations via mid-run text prompts.
